cars.variant: Toronado Deluxe 425 coupe — 1966 USA original brochure, Turbo Hydra-Matic
cars.specification_market: 1966 USA Toronado Deluxe coupe, original factory brochure printed 9-65. Count the first-generation 1966–1970 Toronado road family once across years, standard/Deluxe trim, engines and later packages. Selected original 425 Rocket V8 and three-speed Turbo Hydra-Matic front drive; not later 455/W-34 or prototype specification. Retain advertised factory horsepower/native units without modern net conversion. Five-passenger height label preserved literally. No road-test speed as maximum speed, prototype snow performance, fuel-economy result or universal curb mass inferred.
cars.summary: The original Toronado is a landmark high-performance grand-touring coupe, combining a powerful V8 with a compact front-wheel-drive powertrain. Motor Trend’s contemporary 1966 Car of the Year cross-country test documents its engineering impact, distinctive design and accomplished handling over 2,769 miles, establishing significance beyond luxury equipment or price.

sources.title: Out Front in 66 — original 1966 Toronado brochure, printed September 1965
sources.source_type: Original manufacturer sales/specification brochure, hosted scan
sources.notes: 13-page scanned file, 11,189,717 bytes. Full indexes 1 (printed 2–3), 11 (22–23) and 12 (back cover) visually read; engineering table on 11 enlarged and read. Back-cover/colophon identify 1966 and print code 9-65. Original 425, Quadrajet, variable-pitch three-speed and chain drive are distinguished from later engines. Shared exterior dimensions apply to this coupe; height retains factory 5-pass. label. Interior trim dimensions and general curb weight not imported. No modern net power convention or first-front-drive-ever claim inferred.

sources.title: 1966 Car of the Year: Toronado Cross-Country Road Test — John Ethridge, December 1965
sources.source_type: Contemporary first-hand road test and award coverage, publisher archive
sources.notes: Originally December 1965; publisher reprint 24 June 2005. The author reports 2,769 road miles, handling and design reactions, with limitations such as high-altitude headlamp operation and windscreen-wiper lift. Used for admission only. Preproduction snow film, test cruising speeds, tank-fill discrepancy and fuel economy are not selected factory specifications.

attributes.label: Fuel system

attributes.label: Internal drive arrangement
attributes.value: Silent-chain drive from torque converter to planetary gears

attributes.label: Front drive shafts
attributes.value: Twin constant-velocity universal joints; rubber-isolated right axle

attributes.label: Front
attributes.value: Ball-joint independent suspension; torsion-bar springs and stabilizer

attributes.label: Rear
